scenes.text: Measure angles with a protractor: acute less than 90 degrees , right equals 90 degrees , obtuse between 90 degrees and 180 degrees , reflex greater than 180 degrees .

Classify an angle of 270 degrees . The answer is reflex. 270 degrees is reflex: acute less than 90 degrees , right equals 90 degrees , obtuse 90–180 degrees , straight equals 180 degrees , reflex greater than 180 degrees .
A protractor reading in the class garden shows 180 degrees . What type of angle is it? Pause the video and think.

A protractor reading in the class garden shows 180 degrees . What type of angle is it? The answer is straight. 180 degrees is straight: acute less than 90 degrees , right equals 90 degrees , obtuse 90–180 degrees , straight equals 180 degrees , reflex greater than 180 degrees .
